completed_steps.summary: Monolito (single part 'landing'). project_type_id=web. Static HTML + Tailwind CDN + AWS serverless (S3/CloudFront/Lambda/API GW v2/SES/Route53). No build pipeline.

Existing docs: README.md (391 lines, detallado), _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/ceo-feedback-dev-brief.md (12 cambios CEO), _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/tech-spec-landing-infra-contact-form.md (spec infra).

Tech stack: HTML5 + Tailwind CSS via CDN (con plugins forms/typography/container-queries) + Swiper.js v11 + Google Fonts (Inter, Space Grotesk) + Material Symbols + Vanilla JS. Backend: Node.js 20.x Lambda + @aws-sdk/client-ses (runtime). Infra: Terraform >=1.0 + AWS Provider ~>5.0.

Analisis exhaustivo: 1 API endpoint (POST /contact), 13 UI sections, 11 assets (~32MB), modal de demo con 6 campos, Swiper carousels (screenshots, testimonials), marquee de logos, IntersectionObserver para scroll animations. Discrepancia detectada: endpoint en index.html (vo29nu6c83) != README (s04r3s9ik7).

Source tree documentado con 4 carpetas criticas (assets/, infra/terraform/, lambdas/contact-form/, _bmad-output/) y 3 entry points (index.html, lambdas/contact-form/index.js, infra/terraform/main.tf).
Dev workflow: open index.html localmente o python3 -m http.server. Deploy: terraform apply (Lambda) + aws s3 sync + cloudfront invalidate. Sin CI/CD ni tests automatizados.
Architecture.md generado: Jamstack simplificado, CloudFront-frente, Lambda-backed contact endpoint, SES para emails, todo en us-east-1, una sola cuenta dev (009160036798).
Supporting docs writeen: project-overview, source-tree-analysis, api-contracts, ui-component-inventory, asset-inventory, development-guide, deployment-guide.
Master index regenerado con navegacion completa y enlaces a 11 docs internos + 2 planning artifacts.
Validacion completa. Todos los archivos esperados existen. Sin markers (To be generated).
